name: @kitr/kit-app
description: kitr new --kit app: The smallest app that runs: pages, data loading and styling, nothing else wired yet.

kitr.name: app
kitr.title: App kit
kitr.summary: Start with pages, data loading and styling, and add sign-in, forms or an API when you need them.

kit.audience: Anyone starting a web app who wants a small, readable project and adds sign-in, forms or an API as the app grows.

highlights.title: Two pages, one route table
highlights.text: `/` and `/about` are listed in `app/routes.ts`, and each is a component in `app/pages/`.

highlights.title: Data loading ready
highlights.text: Query is wired, so the first `queryOptions` you write caches, refetches and suspends.

highlights.title: Styled from the first render
highlights.text: Tailwind and the theme tokens, with light and dark mode and no flash.

run: The app in the browser, with hot reload
Vitest, starting with the home page test
